content: Home Manager manual+FAQ (HIGH): home-manager.useGlobalPkgs=true uses the global system pkgs (saves an extra nixpkgs eval, removes NIX_PATH dependency) and DISABLES the HM nixpkgs.* options - overlays/allowUnfree must then live at the NixOS level; HM FAQ 'change-package-module' confirms overlays put in nixpkgs.overlays are ignored under useGlobalPkgs. useUserPackages=true installs home.packages via NixOS users.users.<name>.packages into /etc/profiles instead of ~/.nix-profile; manual warns you must source the correct hm-session-vars path depending on useUserPackages (env breakage when migrating, nixos-rebuild build-vm needs it). Discourse: useGlobalPkgs changes what pkgs means and may break unfree allowance; both options exist ONLY in the NixOS-module wrapper (lib/build.nix), not in standalone homeManagerConfiguration - shared home modules must not reference them. useUserPackages sets users.users.<name>.packages (recursion fixed in PR #6622 by pulling instead of pushing). NixOS module double-declares users (users.users + home-manager.users); multiple imports of the HM nixos module cause 'option home-manager.users already declared'.
